title: Chai Jing's review: Under the Dome – Investigating China’s Smog 柴静雾霾调查：穹顶之下 (full translation)
summary: Chai Jing's 104-minute documentary on China's smog, with full English subtitles. A former TV anchor, she investigates what smog is, where it comes from and what can be done, prompted by her daughter's health problems.
why: Recommended as an accessible, powerful introduction to severe urban air pollution, remembered also for being banned in China.

quote.text: I highly recommend the documentary Under the Dome , released earlier this year and later banned in China
